response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as total_projects FROM scanqc), project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref) SELECT project_counts.arcref, project_counts.cnt as count, project_counts.cnt::numeric / totals.total_records as share, (project_counts.cnt::numeric / totals.total_records) - (1.0 / totals.total_projects) as deviation FROM project_counts CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is 1 / (number of distinct projects in QC data), representing the share each project would receive if QC records were evenly distributed.
